signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.failed: Sign-in failed. Try again in a moment.
signIn.disabled: Your account has been disabled. Ask your administrator if you think this is a mistake.
signIn.sessionRevoked: Your session has ended. Sign in again — if your account was re-enabled, choose a new password with “Forgot your password?”.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your account's email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a link to reset its password is on its way. It works once and expires in one hour. You can ask for another in a few minutes.

register.title: Register your company
register.description: Create your company's TonyAI account. You will be its first administrator.
register.codeHint: The five-character code TonyAI gave you. Capital and small letters are different.
register.codeInvalid: This registration code is not valid. Check the code you were given.
register.noticePlaceholder: Placeholder text — not the final notice
register.notice: This is placeholder text standing in for TonyAI's personal data protection notice under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK). The final notice will explain which personal data is collected at registration (your name, job title and company email address), why and on what legal basis it is processed, who it is shared with, how long it is kept, and how you can use your rights. This text will be replaced before the service opens to customers.
register.consent: I have read the personal data notice and I consent to the processing of my personal data as it describes.
register.consentRequired: Accept the personal data notice to register.
register.incomplete: Fill in every field to register.
register.companyNameTooShort: The company name needs at least 2 characters.
register.sent: If {email} does not have an account yet, an email with a link to confirm the address and choose a password is on its way. The link works once and expires in one hour.
register.sentExisting: Already have an account? Sign in, or reset your password from the sign-in page.
register.unavailable: Registration is not open at the moment. If your company was invited, contact TonyAI.
register.loadFailed: Check your connection and try again.
register.outdatedTitle: This page is out of date
register.outdated: The registration form has been updated since this page was loaded. Reload the page to continue.

confirm.inviteDescription: Continue to confirm your email address, then choose your password.
confirm.recoveryDescription: Continue to choose a new password.
confirm.invalidInvite: It has expired or was already used. If you have not set a password yet, request a new link below. If that does not work, ask your administrator.
confirm.invalidRecovery: It has expired or was already used. Request a new link below.
confirm.malformed: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email.

setPassword.title: Choose your password
setPassword.description: Use at least {min} characters. A long phrase is stronger than a short, complicated word.
setPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setPassword.weak: This password is too weak. Choose a longer one.
setPassword.same: Choose a password different from your current one.
setPassword.failed: The password could not be saved. Try again.
setPassword.noSession: Your link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
